fundamental.text: Raw sugar is 2.27¢/lb above hydrous-ethanol parity in Brazil, so mills favour sugar in the mix (more supply). Sugar in BRL at R$2,275/t (56th pct of 5 yrs). Brazil's election outcome weakened the real, improving mills' export returns and triggering fund selling that pushed raw sugar to new lows early in the week. Desk read: The Brazilian real weakened more than 1% against the dollar, which encourages Brazilian mills to sell export sugar forward and knocked raw sugar back below 18.2. Firmer crude helps the ethanol side, but currency is the bigger driver today; India's fast start still sets the supply tone.
